description: A three-dimensional folder whose flap opens on click; the papers come out, peek when hovered, and can be dropped anywhere by dragging.
interactionNotes: Clicking the folder body opens and closes it; while open, hovering a paper lifts it, a click zooms it, and dragging takes it out of the folder. Clicking outside or Escape closes it. Papers that came out go back by dragging them into the folder again.

props.items: What the folder holds, at most 6 entries. Each entry can be a string, `{ title, description }`, `{ image, title, alt }`, `{ content }`, or a React element.
props.children: Custom documents as children; each child becomes a paper (it takes precedence over `items`).
props.mode: `flap` keeps the folder upright and opens its flap; `book` lays it flat and turns the cover like a book.
props.variant: The folder's material; `glass` makes the flap refractive glass and shows the papers inside through it.
props.layout: Arrangement of the papers when the folder is open: free spread, vertical stack, or tidy row.
props.color: Color of the folder; shadows and the light/dark layers are derived from it. Omit it to stay in tune with the mono surface theme; the blue `#3b82f6` is only the accent of the dock's blue slot.
props.label: Text of the tab label; the tab grows to fit the text.
props.tabPosition: Where the tab sits on the top edge (in right-to-left layout, `right` is the start side).
props.openOn: Open on click, or while the pointer is over the folder.
props.onOpenChange: Called on every open or close.
props.onItemClick: On clicking a paper, when the folder is open or the paper has been taken out.
props.onItemDrop: On releasing a dragged paper; `inside` says whether it landed inside the folder or outside.
props.draggable: Allow dragging papers out of the folder and dropping them anywhere.
props.zoomOnClick: Clicking a paper brings it close; another click, Escape, or an outside click returns it.
props.peek: On hover the papers peek out a little; in flap mode, the paper under the pointer lifts more.
props.intro: When it comes into view, the papers drop in and the folder closes over them.
props.frost: Amount of glass frosting, 0 to 1; only with `variant='glass'`.
props.tilt: How much the folder tilts toward the pointer, 0 to 1.5.
props.bounce: How much the flap/cover/papers bounce when settling, 0 to 1.
props.closeOnOutsideClick: Close on an outside click or Escape.
props.theme: Matches the shadows and focus to a dark or light theme.
props.style: Inline style; it sits after the color variables.

tips: Keep the label short and Persian; the tab grows with the text width and does not overflow the edge.
The paper drawing reads direction from CSS; keep `dir="rtl"` on the page or parent so Persian lines are laid out from the right.
`variant='glass'` gives the best result on WebGL2; without it you still get the same CSS glass with `backdrop-filter`.
Papers can be dragged out and dropped back in; `onItemDrop` tells you which case happened.
Under `prefers-reduced-motion` the intro and the springs calm down; content and accessibility stay untouched.
For narrow cards lower `size`; the spread-open papers need more width than the folder itself.
